```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(tabulapdf)
library(DT)

neuro2_available <- requireNamespace("neuro2", quietly = TRUE)
if (neuro2_available) library(neuro2)

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 50 * 1024^2)

# Exact column order from example CSV
col_order <- c(
 "scale","raw_score","score","percentile","range","ci_95",
 "test","test_name","domain","subdomain","narrow",
 "pass","verbal","timed","test_type","score_type","absort","description","result"
)

# 7 predefined areas (top, left, bottom, right) - FIXED for CVLT-3 Brief format
areas <- list(
  c(166, 52, 237, 560),  # 1: Learning Trials (4 rows)
  c(159, 52, 185, 560),  # 2: Trials 1-4 Correct index
  c(289, 52, 343, 560),  # 3: Delayed Recall (3 rows)
  c(397, 52, 467, 560),  # 4: Recognition (4 rows)
  c(520, 52, 544, 560),  # 5: Intrusions (1 row)
  c(273, 52, 296, 560),  # 6: Repetitions (1 row)
  c(597, 52, 619, 459)   # 7: Forced-Choice (1 row)
)

# Complete metadata matching example CSV exactly
meta <- tribble(
  ~scale, ~domain, ~subdomain, ~narrow, ~pass, ~verbal, ~timed, ~test_type, ~score_type, ~absort, ~description,
  "Trial 1 Correct", "Memory", "Learning Efficiency", "Word-List Learning", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_trial 1 correct_1", "Correct number of words learned on the first trial",
  "Trial 2 Correct", "Memory", "Learning Efficiency", "Word-List Learning", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_trial 2 correct_2", "Correct number of words learned on the second trial",
  "Trial 3 Correct", "Memory", "Learning Efficiency", "Word-List Learning", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_trial 3 correct_3", "Correct number of words learned on the third trial",
  "Trial 4 Correct", "Memory", "Learning Efficiency", "Word-List Learning", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_trial 4 correct_4", "Correct number of words learned on the fourth trial",
  "Trials 1-4 Correct", "Memory", "Learning Efficiency", "Word-List Learning", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "standard_score", "cvlt3_brief_trials 1-4 correct_1", "Learning and recall of rote verbal information (word list)",
  "Short Delay Free Recall", "Memory", "Delayed Recall", "Free-Recall Memory", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_short delay free recall_1", "Recall of the list after a short delay",
  "Long Delay Free Recall", "Memory", "Delayed Recall", "Free-Recall Memory", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_long delay free recall_2", "Recall of the list after a long (20-minute) delay",
  "Long Delay Cued Recall", "Memory", "Delayed Recall", "Free-Recall Memory", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_long delay cued recall_3", "Recall of the list after a long (20-minute) delay with cues",
  "Total Hits", "Memory", "Delayed Recall", "Recognition Memory", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_total hits_1", "Yes/no recognition total hits",
  "Total False Positives", "Memory", "Delayed Recall", "Recognition Memory", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_total false positives_2", "Yes/no recognition total false positives",
  "Recognition Discriminability (d')", "Memory", "Delayed Recall", "Recognition Memory", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_recognition discriminability (d')_3", "Yes/no recognition discriminability",
  "Recognition Discriminability Nonparametric", "Memory", "Delayed Recall", "Recognition Memory", "Sequential", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_recognition discriminability nonparametric_4", "Yes/no recognition discriminability (nonparametric)",
  "CVLT-3 Total Intrusions", "Attention/Executive", "Attentional Functioning", "Response Monitoring", "Attention", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_cvlt-3 total intrusions_1", "Total number of intrusive response errors",
  "CVLT-3 Total Repetitions", "Attention/Executive", "Attentional Functioning", "Response Monitoring", "Attention", "Verbal", "Untimed", "npsych_test", "scaled_score", "cvlt3_brief_cvlt-3 total repetitions_1", "Total number of repetitive response errors",
  "CVLT-3 Forced-Choice Recognition Hits", "Performance Validity", "Cognitive Effort", "Forced-Choice Recognition Memory", "", "Verbal", "Untimed", "validity_indicator", "raw_score", "cvlt3_brief_cvlt-3 forced-choice recognition hits_1", "Number of hits on forced-choice recognition trials (raw score)"
)

# Which table contributes which scales (in order)
table_scales <- list(
  c("Trial 1 Correct", "Trial 2 Correct", "Trial 3 Correct", "Trial 4 Correct"),
  c("Trials 1-4 Correct"),
  c("Short Delay Free Recall", "Long Delay Free Recall", "Long Delay Cued Recall"),
  c("Total Hits", "Total False Positives", "Recognition Discriminability (d')", "Recognition Discriminability Nonparametric"),
  c("CVLT-3 Total Intrusions"),
  c("CVLT-3 Total Repetitions"),
  c("CVLT-3 Forced-Choice Recognition Hits")
)
```

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar

fileInput("file", "Upload CVLT-3 Brief PDF", accept = ".pdf")

hr()
h5("Page Numbers Only")
helpText("Areas are fixed. Adjust pages for your PDF.")

numericInput("p1", "Table 1 (Learning):", value = 3, min = 1)
numericInput("p2", "Table 2 (Trials 1-4 Index):", value = 7, min = 1)
numericInput("p3", "Table 3 (Delayed):", value = 3, min = 1)
numericInput("p4", "Table 4 (Recognition):", value = 3, min = 1)
numericInput("p5", "Table 5 (Intrusions):", value = 3, min = 1)
numericInput("p6", "Table 6 (Repetitions):", value = 9, min = 1)
numericInput("p7", "Table 7 (Forced-Choice):", value = 3, min = 1)

hr()
selectInput("method", "Method:", c("stream", "lattice"), "stream")
actionButton("go", "Extract", class = "btn-success btn-lg")
downloadButton("dl", "Download CSV")
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill

verbatimTextOutput("status")
tabsetPanel(
  tabPanel("Raw Tables", uiOutput("raw_ui")),
  tabPanel("Final CSV", DTOutput("final_tbl"))
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

safe_num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", x)))

rv <- reactiveValues(tables = NULL, final = NULL)

pages <- reactive(c(input$p1, input$p2, input$p3, input$p4, input$p5, input$p6, input$p7))

observeEvent(input$go, {
  req(input$file)
  pgs <- pages()
  
  withProgress(message = "Extracting 7 tables...", {
    rv$tables <- lapply(1:7, function(i) {
      incProgress(1/7, detail = paste("Table", i))
      tryCatch({
        res <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
          file = input$file$datapath,
          pages = pgs[i],
          area = list(areas[[i]]),
          method = input$method,
          guess = FALSE,
          output = "data.frame"
        )
        if (length(res) > 0) res[[1]] else NULL
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    })
  })
  
  # Process tables
  all_rows <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:7) {
    df <- rv$tables[[i]]
    scales <- table_scales[[i]]
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) < length(scales)) next
    
    # Assume columns: Scale, Raw, Scaled, Percentile (adjust indices as needed)
    nc <- ncol(df)
    for (j in seq_along(scales)) {
      row <- df[j, ]
      all_rows[[length(all_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        scale = scales[j],
        raw_score = if (nc >= 2) safe_num(row[[2]]) else NA,
        score = if (i == 7) NA else if (nc >= 3) safe_num(row[[3]]) else NA,
        percentile = if (i == 7) 50 else if (nc >= 4) safe_num(row[[4]]) else NA
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (length(all_rows) == 0) {
    showNotification("No data extracted", type = "error")
    return()
  }
  
  result <- bind_rows(all_rows) |>
    left_join(meta, by = "scale") |>
    mutate(
      test = "cvlt3_brief",
      test_name = "CVLT-3 Brief",
      ci_95 = NA_character_,
      range = NA_character_
    )
  
  # Apply ranges if neuro2 available
  if (neuro2_available && exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))) {
    result <- neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(result, test_type = "npsych_test")
  }
  
  result <- result |>
    mutate(result = ifelse(!is.na(description) & !is.na(range),
                           paste0(description, " was ", range, "."), NA_character_)) |>
    select(any_of(col_order))
  
  rv$final <- result
})

output$status <- renderText({
  n <- if (!is.null(rv$tables)) sum(!sapply(rv$tables, is.null)) else 0
  f <- if (!is.null(rv$final)) nrow(rv$final) else 0
  paste0("Tables extracted: ", n, "/7 | Scales: ", f, "/15")
})

output$raw_ui <- renderUI({
  req(rv$tables)
  tabs <- lapply(1:7, function(i) {
    tabPanel(paste("T", i), renderDT(datatable(rv$tables[[i]], options = list(scrollX = TRUE))))
  })
  do.call(tabsetPanel, tabs)
})

output$final_tbl <- renderDT({
  req(rv$final)
  datatable(rv$final, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20), rownames = FALSE)
})

output$dl <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() paste0("cvlt3_brief_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
  content = function(file) write.csv(rv$final, file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
)
```
